_meta.what: the share of each GPU family among Windows personas: the Windows pool is made of the devices of win_gfx_devices.json (their `pool_family`, `weight`), and the weights of the devices of a family add up to the family's weight here
_meta.method: vendor split: Firefox Public Data Report week 2026-11-02 (all desktop; Apple and 'Other' vendors dropped, renormalised over Intel/AMD/NVIDIA); Intel families: the report's codenames; AMD Vega iGPU: the report's GFX9 rows, rest of AMD split by Steam Oct 2026 rows; NVIDIA split by Steam Oct 2026 rows (DX12 table). Inside a family each device weighs the share of the models it covers (Steam) or of its codename (report), scaled to the family's weight
_meta.windows_persona: Windows 11 24H2: a family whose CPUs Windows 11 does not support has no device

absorbed.intel_gen9: Skylake GT2 3.91, Kaby Lake GT1.5 1.94 and Gemini Lake 1.14 (report rows, CPUs Windows 11 does not support) are not devices: their share goes to the Coffee Lake and Kaby Lake R devices
absorbed.intel_gen12: Meteor Lake 1.36 (its adapter name sanitizes to the Arc A750 bucket, which the pool has no WebGL parameters for) is not a device: its share goes to the other gen12 devices

uncovered.intel_other_older_or_small: the report's 'Other' Intel rows: no model and no device id; nothing to declare
uncovered.intel_gen7.5: Haswell: a CPU Windows 11 does not support; no measured device (no Windows 11 driver data). Left out of the pool because a Windows 10 persona is not built yet: its system fonts are not the measured Windows 10 ones, so it would show Windows 11 fonts on a Windows 10 machine.
uncovered.intel_gen7: Ivy Bridge: a CPU Windows 11 does not support (HD 4000 measured, left out of a Windows 11 persona). Left out of the pool because a Windows 10 persona is not built yet: its system fonts are not the measured Windows 10 ones, so it would show Windows 11 fonts on a Windows 10 machine.
uncovered.intel_gen6: Sandy Bridge: a CPU Windows 11 does not support; no measured device. Left out of the pool because a Windows 10 persona is not built yet: its system fonts are not the measured Windows 10 ones, so it would show Windows 11 fonts on a Windows 10 machine.
uncovered.amd_other: the report's and Steam's remaining AMD rows: no model, no device id
uncovered.nv_other: NVIDIA rows outside the generations of the table: no model, no device id
uncovered.nv_kepler_maxwell: Kepler: sanitizes to the GeForce GTX 480 bucket, which the pool has no WebGL parameters for
uncovered.nv_older: pre-Kepler: sanitizes to a bucket the pool has no WebGL parameters for
uncovered.nv_other_pro: workstation cards: no model, no device id
